artifact: Unchanged rule: if review result is changes_requested, select return_for_edits; otherwise, if release date is later than run date 2031-04-12, select wait; otherwise select post. Keep notice records unchanged.
explanation: The current rule already implements all requirements: changes_requested takes priority regardless of release date, and approved notices are posted on or after their release date and wait before it. Both required values are readable, so no rule or record changes are necessary.
